name: Haitoku no Kyousei Tanetsuke ~ Ai Suru Tsuma no Naka ni Sosogikomareru Hoka no Otoko no Seieki
original_name: 背徳の強制種付け ～愛する妻の子宮（なか）に注ぎ込まれる他の男の精液
source:
When Yuuto was a college student, he kindly helped a beautiful woman who got lost in the city. Attracted to his kindness, the woman Houshou Kotoko, fell in love with him at first sight. Guided by her passionate love, they eventually got married.

However, their marriage is also the beginning of the difficult days for the two of them.

As a matter of fact, Kotoko is the only child of the upper class Houshou family which owns many successful businesses, and originally, she is supposed to marry a man from a prestigious family, chosen by her parents. Although Kotoko's strong feelings manage to tie the two of them together, the Houshou family strongly disapproves of their relationship, and only tries to force them to divorce. 

Their only hope left, is to have a child. Promised to barely tolerate them if they can leave behind a child, the Houshou family demands them to get conceived.

Kotoko tries hard to get pregnant, but it is discovered that there is a problem with Yuuto's sperm which make it difficult to conceive a child.

In the midst of despair...... Yuuto takes Kotoko for the first time, to his parents' home, the Ikushima family. A family member who has learned of Yuuto's situation── His father Isao, comes up with a certain sinister scheme, offering Kototo, his sperm donation. The worried Kototo, who is grasping at the straws, refuses. But later becomes determined in order to protect her beloved husband.

Thus, the immoral sex in the guise of sperm donation between the [i]ojousama[/i] Kototo and her husband's father begins......

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1230202]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
勇斗在大学时，曾好心帮助一位在城市迷路的美丽女子。被他的善良所吸引，女人方胜琴子对他一见钟情。在她炽热的爱情的指引下，他们最终结婚了。

然而，他们的婚姻也是两人艰难日子的开始。

事实上，琴子是拥有众多成功企业的上层阶级丰收家族的独生女，原本她应该嫁给父母选定的名门望族的男人。虽然琴子的强烈感情将两人联系在一起，但丰受家族却强烈反对他们的关系，并试图强迫他们离婚。

他们唯一的希望就是生一个孩子。厚守一家承诺，如果能留下孩子，就勉强容忍他们，但要求他们怀孕。

琴子努力怀孕，却发现雄斗的精子有问题，难以怀孕。

绝望之中……勇斗第一次带着琴子，来到了父母的家，生岛家。得知勇斗情况的家人──他的父亲勋想出了一个险恶的计划，向琴斗提供了他的精子捐赠。忧心忡忡的琴托抓住了救命稻草，拒绝了。但后来为了保护心爱的丈夫而下定决心。

于是，[i]ojousama[/i]琴与丈夫的父亲之间以捐精为幌子的不道德性行为开始了……
